d: Apple has launched its first touchscreen MacBook, years after Steve Jobs dismissed the idea as “ergonomically terrible”. The new models start at $2,899 for the 14-inch version and $3,399 for the 16-inch version, while top configurations cost more than $14,000. But touchscreen laptops are hardly new, with Windows manufacturers offering them for more than a decade. The launch comes amid a faster hardware push under new CEO John Ternus, while Apple remains behind rivals such as Microsoft and Google in artificial intelligence.
